description: A discrete-time deterministic SEIR-type model that divides the population into Susceptible (S), Exposed (E), Infectious (I), and Removed (R) compartments, with the E and I compartments further divided into two sub-compartments each (E1, E2 and I1, I2). The model links the underlying transmission dynamics to data on severe influenza cases (ICU/HDU admissions) to infer parameters like the effective reproduction number, initial susceptibility, and the probability of ICU admission given infection.
